data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for iOS and Android to decode QR codes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a plugin for decoding QR codes from local files on Android and iOS.
use_when: You need to decode a QR code from a local image file
You are building an app for Android and iOS that requires QR code reading capabilities
avoid_when: You need live camera preview scanning instead of local file decoding
You need web or desktop support
strengths: Simple API for decoding QR codes from local files
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only iOS and Android)
data.setup_notes: For iOS, add the Privacy - Photo Library Usage Description key to Info.plist.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive scanner widget for real-time camera scanning.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Uses Google ML Kit for robust barcode and QR code scanning.
